news.title: Ford’s EV pickup is almost here, promising much more than an affordable price tag
news.description: The Ford Fathom will go on sale in early 2027, starting at $28,350. Ford said the electric pickup is on track to go into production at its Louisville Assembly plant in Q1 2027.

news.title: ‘Lanterns’ Stars Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre Like Each Other a Lot More Than Hal Jordan and John Stewart Do
news.description: As dueling Green Lanterns in the new live-action HBO series, the actors take on iconic characters with some serious history. They tell IndieWire about their own comic book beginnings, real-life heroes, and their bond.
